name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
title: Vedant Fashions Ltd - 543463 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competitors' stores are closing: "the number of stores have started to come down in these 8 states at least"

summary.headline: Vedant Fashions Q1 FY27 revenue from operations rose 7.2% to INR3,014 mn, with PAT up 14.7% to about INR81 crore and domestic SSG at 3.8%.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 retail sales (customer sales) of INR4,195 mn, up 3.4% YoY, with domestic SSG ex-SIS of about 3.8%. Revenue from operations was about INR3,014 mn (INR301 crore), up 7.2%, with gross margin of 65.7% and EBITDA margin of 44.6%. EBITDA grew 10.8% and PAT margin was 26.7%. Store closures were elevated in Q1 by design, with openings pushed to H2, and management said closures and competitor exits are reducing industry store count in about 8 top states.

financial_highlights.change: vs 65.0% in Q4 FY26; YoY decline attributed partly to GST

financial_highlights.metric: Cash conversion (TTM June 2026, OCF/PAT excl. finance income)

segments.name: Manyavar / Mohey (core and non-bridal push)
segments.commentary: Mohey is growing faster than company average; push into stitched suits, sarees and crop-top lehengas. Manyavar's mega campaign with Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda reportedly exceeded 1 billion views.

segments.name: Twamev (premium)
segments.commentary: Management said Twamev outperformed the company in overall growth in Q1.

segments.name: Diwas
segments.commentary: Launched about a year ago; Q1 not reflective of its progress. Majority of MBO/SIS bookings for Q2 done; e-commerce deals signed with Myntra, Amazon, Blinkit and Zepto.

segments.name: MBO + SIS + e-commerce
segments.commentary: Together about 5% of revenue today; new leadership team built and growth targets described as aggressive. SIS is a few hundred sq ft versus EBO average of about 3,000 sq ft.

segments.name: International (UAE, North America)
segments.commentary: Under pressure: UAE affected by war, North America by tariffs. No growth figures given.

guidance_outlook: Core goal is a strong SSG in FY27; management said a net positive store count for the year is expected despite closures.
Gross openings to be concentrated in H2 (end of Q2 and early Q3), with openings at about 3-4% of store base as a typical annual tail; openings to accelerate as rental pressure eases.
Revenue growth target for FY27 relies on SSG, productivity uplift from new versus closed stores, net openings and MBO/SIS/e-commerce growth.
Asked about high-single-digit SSG for the remaining nine months: management called it a fair understanding and said FY27 will still be net positive.
ASP growth ambition slightly above plan; expected to start materialising from mid-Q2. Q1 SSG was split roughly half volume and half price.
Wedding calendar: November to March expected to be fantastic; October may be weaker YoY because Navratri was pushed by Adhik maas; January has wedding dates this year versus none last year.
capex_capacity: Q1 closures were deliberately front-loaded; management avoids carrying loss-making stores into the Q2 off-season, with openings aimed at H2.
Closure reasons cited: market shifted to newer locations, cannibalisation by a larger store in a nearby bigger town, and early new-store mistakes. Competition was not cited as a reason.
Franchisee capex: about INR2,100-2,150 per sq ft in Tier 2/3 cities and about INR2,500 per sq ft in Tier 1.
Franchisee revenue break-even benchmarks per sq ft: about INR7,000 (Tier 3), INR8,500 (Tier 2), INR10,000-10,500 (Tier 1). Management said franchisee ROI is currently good.
Internal research covers about 8 top states; net closures now seen in many states versus last quarter.
demand_pricing: Q1 SSG of about 3.8% split roughly evenly between volume and price.
Management said competitors that entered 3-4 years ago are closing large stores while new players add, and that industry store count was not rising.
Celebration wear dead stock is hard to liquidate at a discount, so management expects weaker players to exit, mainly regional and local ones.
Management said it is too early to link competitor closures to its own growth and wants 2-3 more quarters of data.
Retention: YoY retention improved; a separate task force targets repeat business; plans to be announced in the next call if finalised this month.
Marketing will shift from top-of-mind branding to consideration and conversion-led social campaigns for Q3.

qa_highlights.question: What are franchisee revenue-per-sq-ft benchmarks, and is franchisee margin under pressure after GST changes?
qa_highlights.answer: Break-even-type benchmarks: about INR7,000/sq ft (Tier 3), INR8,500 (Tier 2), INR10,000-10,500 (Tier 1). Management said franchisee ROI is good and there is no pressure.

qa_highlights.question: Why close stores at an accelerated pace if competition is the issue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said competition has never been a closure reason. Closures were from market shifts, cannibalisation by larger nearby stores, and early mistakes. Q1 was front-loaded to avoid off-season rentals.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin trend YoY: will it stabilise at 65-65.5%?
qa_highlights.answer: GM was 65.7% in Q1 FY27 versus 65.0% in Q4 FY26, so it improved sequentially. GST was not in the base in Q1 and entered the base from Q3, which explains YoY comparisons.

qa_highlights.question: Primary vs secondary sales gap despite Adhik maas impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Replenishment is auto-driven, so quarterly gaps vary. Management asked analysts to review primary and secondary at full-year level, where directions align.

qa_highlights.question: Plans for revenue growth of low-to-mid teens, and how to fund square footage addition?
qa_highlights.answer: Majority from SSG, plus closed-vs-new store productivity delta, net openings, and aggressive MBO/SIS/e-commerce targets. No specific square footage number given.

qa_highlights.question: Is Mohey scaling and what are the steps?
qa_highlights.answer: Mohey performing better than company average; doubling down on non-bridal categories (stitched suits, sarees, crop-top lehengas) and digital marketing for them.

qa_highlights.question: Share of MBO, SIS and e-commerce in revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: About 5% combined today, with aggressive growth targets.

risks_watch: Store closures front-loaded in Q1 (openings pushed to end-Q2/early-Q3); management said net store count for FY27 stays positive, so H2 opening execution and rental pressure easing are the key checks.

Delivery of SSG: management called high-single-digit SSG for the remaining nine months a fair understanding; Q1 SSG was about 3.8% and only about half volume-driven, so ASP ambition (expected to start from mid-Q2) needs tracking.
Competitor exits: management said it is too early to link closures to its own growth and wants 2-3 more quarters of data; the 8-state internal study is still incomplete.
Gross margin: 65.7% in Q1 FY27 with GST not yet in the base until Q3; YoY comparisons will shift once GST enters the base.
MBO, SIS and e-commerce (about 5% of revenue) carry aggressive growth targets with new leadership; no specific square footage or revenue split was given for FY27 growth of low-to-mid teens.
International (UAE, North America) under pressure from war and tariffs with no growth figures disclosed; October may be weaker YoY given Navratri shift from Adhik maas.
key_quotes: So, to be very honest with you, I think regarding closures, I have never faced a reason for a closure to be competition.
And I think we are already quite confident of the kind of numbers we'll achieve in that vertical.
So, I think definitely, that intensity will go down.
So it's too early to comment on anything of this sort.
So I think ideally, we would want to see this for another 2 to 3 quarters before we give a final analysis of this understanding.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the H2 recovery, product lineup, wedding calendar and franchisee ROI, but cautious and non-committal on the competitor-exit thesis, the MBO/SIS/e-commerce ramp and the pace of store openings, and gave no figures for International. Answers on primary vs secondary and on the market size were deflective, pointing analysts to full-year reviews.

adds.what: Gross store openings concentrated in H2 FY27 (end of Q2 and early Q3); net store count expected positive for FY27 after elevated Q1 closures

growth.why: Management targets a strong FY27 SSG (analyst framing of high single digits for the remaining nine months, which management called a fair understanding) and a net positive store count, with gross openings weighted to H2; Q1 revenue rose 7.2% and EBITDA 10.8%, but store closures were elevated and no specific revenue growth percentage was given.
